source_name: Centrální nákup Plzeňského kraje – E-ZAK (ezak.cnpk.cz)
why_relevant: Regional central purchasing body. Central purchasers are exactly where framework agreements for bank accounts, card acceptance and payment services get consolidated for a whole region.

source_name: Veřejné zakázky statutárního města Brna (zakazky.brno.cz)
why_relevant: Buyer portal of the second-largest Czech city, linked to its statutory profil zadavatele. Brno's ecosystem (DPMB validators, elektronické šalinkarty) makes it a high-signal buyer for transport payment acceptance.

source_name: E-ZAK město Třebíč (zakazky.trebic.cz) – example mid-size municipal instance
why_relevant: Representative of the long tail of mid-size cities running their own E-ZAK; observed to publish parking-related contracts. Confirms that the same crawler template scales from Prague down to district towns.

source_name: E-ZAK Městská část Praha 8 (ezak.praha8.cz)
why_relevant: Example of a Prague city district running its own instance. Districts buy school-canteen payment systems, cashless collection of fees and small POS/terminal contracts that never reach central portals in searchable form.

source_name: Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy – profil zadavatele (Tender arena)
why_relevant: City-owned transport operator; the buyer of validators, on-board ticketing terminals, acquiring and EMV open-loop acceptance for Prague public transport. Highest-value single payments buyer in the municipal sphere.

source_name: Golemio / data.praha.eu – Veřejné zakázky DPP, THMP, PSAS dashboards (open data)
why_relevant: Prague's open-data platform republishes buyer-profile data for the city and its companies (DPP, THMP, PSAS), updated daily since Oct 2021, including small-scale contracts, DNS and framework agreements — i.e. structured data instead of HTML scraping for the largest municipal buyer group.

source_name: TSK Praha – parking payment app policy and third-party app onboarding
why_relevant: City-owned road administrator that sets how parking is paid in Prague. Announced the end of MPLA support (31.12.2025), the city 'Online parkovací automat' at parking.praha.eu, and an open onboarding process for third-party payment apps at a 4% distribution fee — a procurement-adjacent market-access mechanism rather than a classic tender.

source_name: Dopravní podnik města Brna (DPMB) – news on card payment / e-ticketing rollout
why_relevant: Operator announcements date and describe validator/EMV rollouts (cited cost ~65m CZK), giving the context and timing needed to locate the underlying tender on the Brno buyer profile and to anticipate replacement cycles.

source_name: Statutární město Ostrava / Dopravní podnik Ostrava – cashless fare announcements
why_relevant: Ostrava is a reference site for open-loop EMV in transport (VEGA CVB25 terminals across 613 vehicles). City and operator communications identify installed base and vendor generation — key for replacement-cycle forecasting and for finding the originating contracts.

source_name: PID / Lítačka (ROPID, Operátor ICT) – Prague integrated transport payment ecosystem
source_subtype: transport authority / city payment app operator
why_relevant: The PID Lítačka app is the flagship city payment app (transport tickets and now parking payment). Its operator (Operátor ICT / hl. m. Praha) is a recurring buyer of payment-gateway, acquiring and app-development services.

source_name: Technologie hlavního města Prahy (THMP) – veřejné zakázky
why_relevant: City technology company managing Prague's urban infrastructure; a buyer for city-app, terminal and technology contracts adjacent to payment acceptance. Also mirrored in Prague open data.

source_name: podo.fen.cz – virtuální profily zadavatelů
why_relevant: Third-party service constructing 'virtual buyer profiles' that consolidate a buyer's tenders across platforms — useful as a cross-check when a municipality has migrated between e-tools and older notices are stranded.

source_name: najdivz.cz and etendry.cz – buyer-profile lookup aggregators
why_relevant: Secondary directories mapping buyer name to profile; useful redundancy against VVZ when a profile URL has moved, and helpful for resolving municipal company names to ICO.

source_name: profilzadavatele.cz / profilzadavatele-vz.cz (QCM) – hosted municipal profiles
why_relevant: Another large hosting family for small and mid-size municipal buyer profiles (e.g. Praha 7 at praha7.profilzadavatele-vz.cz). Covering it closes a big share of the long tail of towns.

source_name: Registr smluv – detailed search interface (Podrobne vyhledavani)
why_relevant: Parameterised search over the register by publisher ICO, counterparty ICO, subject text, value range and publication date. This is the practical entry point for building a banking/payments supplier watchlist (e.g. ICO of Komercni banka, CSOB, Ceska sporitelna, Global Payments, Worldline, Monet+, Printec) and pulling their public-sector contract book.

source_name: Registr smluv open data – monthly XML dumps (data.smlouvy.gov.cz)
why_relevant: Bulk machine-readable metadata for the entire register: dump_<YYYY>_<MM>.xml files plus index.xml with size, generation timestamp, SHA hash and a 'dokonceny mesic' completeness flag. This is the backbone for any longitudinal analysis of banking/payment contract volumes, values and supplier shares back to 2016.

source_name: data.isrs.cz – ISRS dump directory listing
why_relevant: Referenced by the official open-data documentation as the directory listing of currently generated dump files for the ISRS. Alternative/companion host to data.smlouvy.gov.cz; useful as a fallback mirror for the bulk pipeline.

source_name: Hlidac statu – Hlidac smluv (contract analytics over the register)
why_relevant: NGO-run re-publication and enrichment of the whole contract register: full-text search over contract PDFs (including OCR of ~30% scanned documents), per-contract error/risk scoring, links between contracts, tenders, subsidies and political financing. Far better for keyword discovery of payment/banking subject matter than the official portal, whose full-text coverage is weaker.

source_name: HlidacStatu/API GitHub repository (apiary.apib spec)
why_relevant: Source-of-truth API blueprint and issue history for the Hlidac endpoints; also reveals the data model (contract fields, party identifiers, classification) that we would mirror in our own store.

source_name: Hlidac statu – subject page for a contracting party (Registr smluv view per ICO)
why_relevant: Per-entity contract book with counts and aggregate values (the CNB page shows 2,223 contracts, ~CZK 8bn). Swap the ICO to get the same view for any bank, PSP, terminal vendor or public buyer — the fastest way to size a supplier's Czech public-sector footprint.

source_name: Hlidac statu – Zakladni statistiky Registru smluv (report 7)
why_relevant: Baseline statistics on register coverage and volumes. Needed to interpret any banking/payments series correctly (publication compliance drift, seasonality, share of contracts without a stated value).

source_name: Hlidac statu – Hlidac Registr smluv state-website monitor entry
why_relevant: Availability/quality monitoring of the smlouvy.gov.cz service itself. Useful operationally: distinguishes 'our fetch failed' from 'the register was down', which matters for a scheduled collector.

source_name: texty.hlidacstatu.cz – Registr smluv article category
why_relevant: Editorial/analytical write-ups by the Hlidac team on register mechanics, loopholes, non-compliance and notable contracts. A pointer source that surfaces new actors, new query terms and known data pitfalls we would otherwise learn the hard way.

source_name: RegistrySmluv.cz – commercial mirror and search over the contract register
why_relevant: Independent index of the register (claims 8.3m+ contracts, complete from 2016) with search, analysis and monitoring features. Value is as a second index for recall testing and for alerting; not a substitute for the primary dumps.

source_name: NKOD / data.gov.cz – dataset 'Smlouvy v Registru smluv'
why_relevant: The national open data catalogue entry for the register: authoritative distribution URLs, update cadence, licence and publisher metadata. The right place to detect if distribution endpoints or formats change, and to discover adjacent public-contract datasets.

source_name: DIA – Digitalni a informacni agentura, Registr smluv service page
why_relevant: Operator of the register since 1 April 2023 (transferred from the Ministry of the Interior). Announces methodology, publication-form and technical changes that would break a collector, and is the addressee for formal information requests.
